{{Quote|Don't hurt me! I don't have anything!|The thief to Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=LizardBoy.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
This [[Unidentified hunched lizard species|alien]] '''individual''' was accomplice to a criminal [[Scavenger (Mos Espa)|scavenger]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Before the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] began, he stole [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[plasma ignition capacitor]] for the scavenger, only to be pursued and cornered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. The thief pleaded with Jinn not to harm him, and the Jedi Master proceeded to take back the capacitor from the scavenger after killing him in a firefight. Jinn spared the thief's life, and returned the capacitor to Skywalker in time for the race.

==Behind the scenes==
He was voiced by [[Bill E. Martin]].
